jobs.title: Data Scientist – Data Integrity

jobs.title: Data Scientist – Founding Role
jobs.snippet: Founding data scientist role with real autonomy to shape technical direction. Build ML models for anomaly detection in unlabelled data at a global scale-up. Massive-scale, real-time data solving complex adversarial ML problems in Sydney or Melbourne.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer

jobs.title: MLOps / AI Platform Engineer

jobs.title: Data Scientist

Deliver AI digital benefits across service and sales hubs. 2–3 years of experience in product, digital, or customer experience.

jobs.title: AI Engineer

jobs.title: AI Engineer

Build scalable AI solutions and integrate machine learning systems into existing platforms. Support development of internal technology tools for data analysis and workflow automation.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer

Your daily responsibilities will encompass designing system and model architectures, conducting rigorous experimentation and model evaluations, and providing guidance to junior ML engineers.

jobs.title: Data Scientist – Innovation Lab

jobs.title: Data Lead Engineer

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.snippet: A Business Analyst position seeking someone to liaise with business and technical stakeholders for delivery of business requirements.

jobs.title: 大模型算法实习生（数字人方向）

jobs.title: AI Infra工程师

jobs.title: 大模型应用和智能体技术算法工程师

jobs.title: 机器学习/数据挖掘算法工程师

jobs.title: 大模型算法研究员（基座）

jobs.title: 机器学习算法实习生

jobs.title: AI算法工程师实习生

jobs.title: 大模型应用算法工程师（转正实习）

jobs.title: 大模型基座团队实习生
jobs.snippet: 美团大模型基座团队招聘实习生，岗位职责包括探索LLM前沿领域研究，涉及数据建设、模型预训练、模型压缩、推理优化、逻辑推理、智能体、MoE、Scaling law和模型评估等工作。该职位要求硕士或博士学位，熟悉Python、Java等编程语言与深度学习框架，具备1年以上NLP经验，熟悉BERT、GPT等模型。实习时长要求6个月以上，每周到岗4天以上。
